Key Specifications and Performance Metrics

  • Drying Chamber Volume: The chott-air spice tray is equipped with an impressive drying chamber volume of 746 litres, ensuring ample space for batch processing and maximizing throughput.
  • Temperature Control: Operating at a consistent air temperature of 50°C, this unit maintains optimal drying conditions, crucial for preserving the quality and integrity of spices.
  • Moisture Removal Capacity: With the ability to remove up to 340 kilograms of moisture per day, the chott-air spice tray delivers exceptional efficiency, significantly reducing processing time and energy consumption.
  • Batch Drying Duration: The system is engineered for batch drying cycles of 82 hours, balancing thorough moisture extraction with operational predictability.
  • Pricing Transparency: The unit price is determined upon acceptance, reflecting a commitment to tailored solutions that meet specific client requirements without compromising on value.
